name: lead_p2v2f
setup: set -e; python3 -m venv /opt/p2venv; /opt/p2venv/bin/pip install -q torch==2.7.0 numpy tokenizers==0.21.1 transformers==4.51.3 safetensors matplotlib pytest; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.data.prepare --download --splits train_10M,train_100M,dev; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -x babylm/tests; if [ -n "${RESTORE_URI:-}" ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$RESTORE_URI" babylm/runs; fi; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_twin_ref-0026.py babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py; mkdir -p babylm/moonshot; [ -f babylm/moonshot/__init__.py ] || touch babylm/moonshot/__init__.py; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_dump_ref-0034.py babylm/moonshot/dev_bpw_dump.py
note: v2f (experimenter 17:50Z, critic ref-0038): base E10 s1 under p2venv torch 2.7, solo; second 2.7 E10 seed to re-derive ENV_SYS vs the solo 2.9 E10 pool. score_trial + twin + temps dump.

jobs.name: v2_S_10M_e10_s1
jobs.cmd: /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_gpu_p2v2f.json --only v2_S_10M_e10_s1; rc=$?; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.analysis.post_runs --pt_runs v2_S_10M_e10_s1; [ -f babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e10_s1/result.json ] && { bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e10_s1 /opt/babylm || echo '[v2] score v2_S_10M_e10_s1 failed'; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e10_s1/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e10_s1/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e10_s1/score/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1 || echo '[twin] v2_S_10M_e10_s1 failed'; mkdir -p babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e10_s1/pt_v2; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.dev_bpw_dump babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e10_s1/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --ws collapse --line_join newline --twin --temps 0.9,0.95,1.05,1.1,1.15,1.2 --out babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e10_s1/pt_v2/dev_v2.npz --check babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e10_s1/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/v2_S_10M_e10_s1/pt_v2/dump.log 2>&1 || echo '[ptv2] v2_S_10M_e10_s1 failed'; }; exit $rc
